mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO wallet_deposit (public_no, chain, provider, provider_ref, tx_hash, to_address, user_id, amount, provider_fee, status, credited_at) VALUES (#{publicNo}, #{chain}, #{provider}, #{providerRef}, #{txHash}, #{to}, #{userId}, #{amount}, #{providerFee}, 'CREDITED', UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM wallet_deposit WHERE provider = #{provider} AND provider_ref = #{ref}
mapper.update: UPDATE wallet_deposit SET status = 'REVERSED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'CREDITED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wallet_suspense (user_id, deposit_id, amount, note) VALUES (#{userId}, #{depositId}, #{amount}, #{note})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM wallet_deposit WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
